EmailTemplate.subject: Important Information Regarding HigherEd Points
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
This letter is to inform you that Flywire is discontinuing the HigherEd Points program.
If you have any information about the program on your website or in your student communications, we ask that you please remove it.
While we regret any inconvenience this announcement may cause, we are here to support you through this change.
Please contact us via our Flywire Client Support Hub <[[http://clientsupport.flywire.com]]>, if you have any questions. Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
